messages:
jamie: quick sync — can we open a small regional canary for the new luna-13b build? want to validate weights URI, tokenizer edge-case, and pin behavior before wide catalog enablement.

maria: I'm good with a canary but need the exact S3 URI + model_config. last time the weights path changed and the release bot failed.

devon: weights are at s3://redwood-models/luna/luna-13b/2026-03-10/weights.tar.gz — mirror at gs://redwood-mirror/luna-13b/weights.tar.gz. tokenizer files in the same directory: tokenizer.json, merges.txt.

jamie: perfect. maria can you run the config lint quickly? i pushed onboarding PR but want a double-check on the pinning semantics.

maria: doing a quick lint now. FYI the tokenizer has a nonstandard unk token property: "<unk_luna>" instead of "<unk>" — runtime needs a mapping or we'll get OOV hits.

srini: thanks — that's new. we should add a small normalization map in model_config.yaml. example snippet: 
```yaml
tokenizer_overrides:
  unk_token: "<unk>"
  remap: 
    "<unk_luna>": "<unk>"
```

devon: runtime can honor tokenizer_overrides if present. need the model config key pinned in the catalog entry as well (so canaries use exact version). propose catalog pin: "luna-13b@2026-03-10+sha256:4a9f"

jamie: sounds good. quick question on rollout policy: start with 10% traffic in us-west, then add eu-west after green. fallback variant? recommend smaller quantized variant "luna-13b-q4" as fallback.

alex: oncall note — ensure canary has oncall alerting enabled (latency spike + increased token error rate). add this to the deploy checklist.

maria: lint done. found two items: 1) model_config.yaml missing 'compiled_kernels' hint (not required but helps runtime choose kernels). 2) tokenizer vocab size doesn't match weights metadata (50256 vs 50250) — likely a merge.txt mismatch.

srini: vocab mismatch is dangerous. can we regenerate merges.txt from the provided vocab or ping tokenizer team?

devon: i can run a quick check: running `python tools/tokenizer_check.py --vocab s3://.../vocab.json --merges s3://.../merges.txt` locally. will report.

ci-bot: build 5421 started for onboarding/luna-13b (sha: 4a9f). logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/5421

jamie: thanks. devon please paste output when done. if it's a trivial merge order issue we can regenerate and reupload to the mirror before canary.

devon: tokenizer check output: 
```
vocab_size=50256
merges_pairs=50250
inconsistent merges found at lines: 1204-1210
recommend regenerating merges from tokenizer training artifact or using provided merges from tokenizer-team v2.
```

maria: i'll open a tiny follow-up with the override + compiled_kernels hint + catalog pin example. can someone review quickly? PR: https://git.redwood/example/pr/2389

srini: reviewing now. Alex can you confirm alerts/SLAs we want for the canary (50rps per instance baseline)?

alex: yes: Pager on error-rate > 0.5% over 5m or latency p95 > 800ms for 2 consecutive windows. Log tokenization errors as metric `tokenizer.oov_errors`.

jamie: sweet. plan: wait for PR merge with fixes, regen merges if needed, push updated mirror, then create canary catalog entry pinned to sha 4a9f, 10% us-west for 1 hour, monitor metrics, then extend to eu-west. fallback variant = luna-13b-q4.

maria: merged PR and uploaded corrected merges.txt to gs://redwood-mirror/luna-13b/merges.txt. updated model_config.yaml includes: 
```yaml
pin: "luna-13b@2026-03-10+sha256:4a9f"
compiled_kernels: ["cuda_attn_v2"]
tokenizer_overrides:
  unk_token: "<unk>"
  remap:
    "<unk_luna>": "<unk>"
```

devon: re-ran tokenizer_check -> all good. builds passing. CI shows no tokenization errors on small test corpus.

ci-bot: build 5421 succeeded. artifact: s3://ci-artifacts/luna-13b/4a9f/serving_bundle.tar.gz

jamie: initiating canary now (10% us-west). tagging catalog entry as canary. will post results after 30m. :rocket:

srini: one last note — add a brief eval set that includes nonstandard names and emojis, helps catch tokenizer weirdness early. i pushed a promptset under evals/luna-13b/edgecases.json.

jamie: great. everyone — thanks for quick turnaround. will follow up in ~30m with metrics. :thumbsup:
